# Niko

> Niko is a Discord bot and companion for community servers. This index links to its complete public documentation and release notes in Markdown format.

## Changelog

- [Economy & Achievements Move to Your Profile](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/personal-economy-tabs.md) — The dashboard's economy and achievements views now sit under My overview as personal tabs, because the Niko economy is one account-wide balance rather than something a server owns, and My servers finally separates the servers Niko is already in from the ones you can add it to.
- [Economy & Leveling Cards Match the Website Theme](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/economy-card-theme-refresh.md) — Every rendered economy and leveling image now uses the same graphite, steel and sage palette as the website and dashboard, retiring the warm café styling that outlived the site theme change.
- [top.gg Voting Rewards & Café Achievements](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/topgg-voting-rewards-and-achievements.md) — Voting for Niko on top.gg now pays coins and builds a streak that boosts your daily and work earnings, with a new set of badges to collect. Both the café standings and every badge are visible in two new dashboard tabs.
- [Global Economy Leaderboard & Privacy](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/global-economy-leaderboard-privacy.md) — The public economy leaderboard is now a paginated global ranking, ranked by net worth, with a dashboard privacy control that lets members protect their identity without leaving the rankings.
- [Dashboard & Community Experience Refresh](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/dashboard-and-community-experience-refresh.md) — A substantial platform update across Niko’s dashboard, public website, Discord integrations, and core bot systems. Guild admins get a redesigned server-profile editor and clearer analytics, while communities benefit from richer Discord-aware transcripts, expanded staff tools, and reliability improvements throughout moderation and data handling.
- [Scam Image Filter (Experimental)](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/scam-image-filter.md) — A community-driven image filter that catches known MrBeast scam images: members report suspicious messages, Niko staff verify them, and confirmed images are then detected and removed automatically — with a feedback loop that lets servers flag false positives to improve accuracy. The feature is still in early testing and may have some reliability issues.
- [Staff Applications](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/staff-applications.md) — Guild dashboards can now manage multiple staff role openings with shareable web forms, Discord membership and eligibility checks, and reusable application links.
- [Logging Reliability & Onboarding Rules](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/server-logging-onboarding-updates.md) — Server event logs are less likely to be delayed during busy periods, and onboarding now gives communities more room to share their rules with new members.
- [UwU Lock Rebuilt & Starboard Persistence](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/uwulock-starboard-overhaul.md) — The UwU Lock command has been completely rebuilt around the main database with immediate webhook reposts, reliable message transforms, and full Starboard integration — with proper author attribution that persists cleanly across restarts.
- [Guild Server Pulse Stats](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/guild-server-pulse-stats.md) — Guild settings now include a Server pulse analytics card with an at-a-glance view of server size and recent community activity.
- [Team Profiles & Custom AI Names](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/team-page-ai-name-config.md) — Niko's public website now introduces the people behind the bot, while server owners can give their AI a custom name and manage its experimental capabilities from the dashboard.
- [September Platform Updates](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/september-platform-updates.md) — A broad set of public improvements landed across Niko: richer ticket transcripts, a multimodal AI experiment, more reliable music playback, a redesigned dashboard experience, persistent giveaways and suggestions, and a refreshed public website with dynamic social previews.
- [Economy Items, Leveling Cards & Subcommands](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/economy-leveling-overhaul.md) — The economy shop expanded with four new consumable items that affect gameplay — Rigged Coin, Streak Insurance, Double Down Token, and Lucky Horseshoe — plus daily streak milestone bonuses at 7, 14, 30, 60, and 90 days. The leveling system now renders rank cards and leaderboards as customizable image cards, and all leveling commands live under a single `/leveling` group with subcommands.
- [Database Migration to MongoDB](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/database-migration.md) — Every major system has been migrated from SQLite to MongoDB. The migration covered economy, leveling, moderation, tickets, birthdays, AFK, sticky messages, warns, mutes, and the blacklist — with a custom interpreter that translates SQLite-style writes to MongoDB operations.
- [Ticket Transcripts & VoiceMaster](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/ticket-system-transcripts.md) — The ticket system gained a web-based transcript viewer that renders ticket conversations as styled HTML pages. The VoiceMaster was also improved with better reliability and database usage. Ticket transcripts can now be downloaded as HTML or viewed online.
- [Roleplay, Music & Status Rotation](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/roleplay-music-status.md) — The roleplay cog was completely rewritten to use nekos.best API GIFs with CV2 layout messages and a persistent 'hug back' button. The music cog was restructured with a ghost queue feature and fixed autoplay/Spotify playback. A status message rotation system was added with a configurable timer.
- [Logging, Moderation & Documentation](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/moderation-logging-dashboard.md) — Logging got two major improvements: deleted message logs now show image attachments in a MediaGallery component, and the Member category now tracks avatar changes using a Section with Thumbnail accessory. The documentation page was fully rebuilt with search, filters, and a card-based layout.
- [Website, Donation System & API](https://niko.sryze.cc/changelog/website-launch-donation.md) — The public website and documentation portal launched with a React + Vite frontend, documentation center with search, and a commands reference page. The donation system gained a dashboard customization page, and the Flask API backend was fixed to use proper database calls.
